editorVerdict: The single best one-room tasting on the Peninsula calendar. Plan the rest of the weekend around it.
editorNote:
Saturday 6 June in the Red Hill Showgrounds pavilions: 35 wineries, 150 wines, an included Riedel glass, food stalls and live music. The $105 masterclass upgrade with Ed Merrison is the smart spend if you actually want to learn something rather than just sip. The $30 designated driver ticket exists so you have no excuse.

For first-timers it's the fastest education in cool-climate Pinot and Chardonnay you'll get. For people who already know the region, it's the only time of year you can taste 30 wineries side by side and pick favourites you'd never otherwise compare.

The move: festival 11am to 4pm Saturday, dinner at Merricks General Store or Polperro that night, cellar-door trail Sunday with a long lunch booked. Accommodation in Red Hill or Merricks, book it now.
